text:
Morgan: Heads-up — ran into weird routing behavior for mixed-dim embed batches during a spike. Some small requests got punted to low-priority pool and timed out.
Tess: Ugh. Can you paste a sample request shape and the routing decision trace? :eyes:
Morgan: Sample payload (trimmed): `{"inputs": [[...]], "dim": 1536}` then a second concurrent `{"inputs": [[...]], "dim": 768}`. Both hit the same tenant ID.
Raj: Are they using the new priority window header? `x-rw-priority-window`? That should keep small latency-sensitive ones on fast path.
Morgan: No header. They came from mobile clients; we didn't want to change SDKs mid-release. We saw route_decision: "fairshare->softqueue->fallback" in logs.
Oliver: Sounds like the fairshare algorithm is treating the large-dim requests as heavy and starving the 768-dim ones because we count units by bytes not vector-dims.
Tess: That's expected currently — quota units = bytes. We debated switching to a dims-aware cost unit last quarter.
Anya: Proposal: change routing cost to max(bytes, dims * 4) so dims lower-bound cost. That would prevent small-dim requests from being overshadowed by very wide vectors encoded inefficiently.
Raj: That would help, but may change billing and quota dashboards. We'd need telemetry mapping to show before/after delta per-tenant.
Morgan: For rollout UX: toggle behind console feature flag + opt-in sampling. No hard switch until we can surface per-route predicted cost in the console.
Oliver: How about a cheap telemetry addition first: emit `ingress_shape_score` with values {small, medium, wide} and include it in the routing decision trace. Then we can A/B the cost change without touching billing.
Tess: I like that — dashboard can show distribution: shape_score vs latency vs failure_rate.
Anya: Also we should add a fast-fail header for clients: `x-rw-embed-fastfail: true` that prompts runtime to return 413-like guidance instead of queuing for >200ms.
Raj: Need to be careful with 413 semantics. Clients expect 413 for payload too large, not backpressure. Maybe 429+body with suggestion: `{"retry_after_ms": 1200, "suggested_split": "by_dim"}`.
Morgan: Example error response we could standardize: `HTTP 429 {"code":"embed_capacity","retry_after_ms":1200,"hint":"split_by_dim_or_shard"}`. SDK can surface helper.
Oliver: Agree on 429. For console rollout, we should add a new widget: "Ingress Shape Heatmap" and a per-tenant "Predicted Unit Cost" estimator that takes a sample payload and shows expected route & cost.
Tess: UX note — keep the estimator inline on the API keys page so devs can copy-paste payloads while reading quota docs.
Anya: Telemetry items to add: shape_score, radi_used_units, route_path, queue_time_ms, decision_version. Make them queryable in logs and in the console metrics UI.
Raj: Also emit a change_event when a tenant's effective unit model switches (bytes->dims-aware) so billing reconciliation is easier.
Morgan: Ops question — do we need a migration window where both cost models are computed and stored? That would let us reconcile impact before cutting over.
Oliver: Yes. Compute both in ingress, persist both metrics for 30 days. Then run tenant impact reports and decide per-tenant rollout.
Tess: Timeline suggestion: week 1 telemetry + estimator widget, week 2 opt-in dims-aware routing behind toggle, week 3 automatic rollout with fallback to bytes if failures > threshold.
Anya: I'll draft the API error schema and the telemetry proto. Can we get a short RFC thread? I'm happy to own the draft.
Morgan: Please do. Add a migration playbook for support so we can explain unit delta to customers.
ingress-bot: Deploy job queued: embed-shape-score:v1 -> staging (scheduled 2026-04-01T03:00Z). :robot_face:
Raj: Nice. Can someone add the console mockups to the RFC? simple heatmap + estimator screenshot will sell it.
Morgan: I'll drop a couple screenshots and an example SDK change for fastfail. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
